messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about how alone I feel.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not dwell on thoughts like “I won’t be able to do my job if I don’t snap out of this.”
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about my feelings of fatigue and achiness.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not think about how hard it is to concentrate.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think “What am I doing to deserve this?”
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not think about how passive and unmotivated I feel.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I analyze recent events to try to understand why I am depressed.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about how I don’t seem to feel anything anymore.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not get stuck thinking “Why can’t I get going?”
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not get stuck thinking “Why do I always react this way?”
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not go away by myself to think about why I feel this way.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I write down what I am thinking about and analyze it.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about a recent situation, wishing it had gone better.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not think “I won’t be able to concentrate if I keep feeling this way.”
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not get stuck thinking “Why do I have problems other people don’t have?”
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think “Why can’t I handle things better?”
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not think about how sad I feel.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about all my shortcomings, failings, faults, and mistakes.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not think about how I don’t feel up to doing anything.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I do not analyze my personality to try to understand why I am depressed.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I go someplace alone to think about my feelings.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I feel down, sad, or depressed, I think about how angry I am with myself.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
